Introduction. Greydwarfs are aggressive creatures found in Black Forests. They are mossy tree-like beings and are twice as strong as their Greyling counterparts.

Attack. Swings their hand sideways in a 1.7-meter 90-degree horizontal arc to scratch the player (14 Slash damage). This attack can be used every 2 seconds when within 1.2 meters of a player.

Throw. Winds their arm back before swinging forward to throw a rock (10 Blunt damage). The rock travels at 12 meters per second for up to 4 seconds before despawning and has a spread of 5 degrees. This attack can be used every 8 seconds when within 5–15 meters of a player.

Notes. • The word Greydwarf is derived from Astrid Lindgren's tale Ronja the Robber's daughter (Ronja Rövardotter). Originally named Grådvärgar, which is literally translated to Greydwarves. They are short creatures with grey fur who will attack a person when they sense the victim's fear. If you are emotionally aggressive then they will leave you be.
